periodic.encoding: PQFPRLE1: magic, then LEB128 varints: column count, row count, per column the run count and each run's canonical value and length

params.hash: Poseidon2KoalaBear<16>: PaddingFreeSponge<_,16,8,8> leaves, TruncatedPermutation<_,2,8,16> nodes, DuplexChallenger<_,_,16,8>
params.mmcs: p3_merkle_tree_ps::MerkleTreeHidingMmcs (the pinned hiding MMCS; each committed matrix's salts regenerated from a 256-bit seed drawn from the MMCS's generator, ChaCha20 with stream = row, instead of stored; openings and verification unchanged)
params.prover: p3_batch_stark_c3np (L0' v2's C3n copy of p3-batch-stark with p3-lookup's permutation-trace generation given the AIR's periodic columns): one instance with periodic control columns, one named LogUp bus (global kind; its terminal must be zero); next-row sets C3nP derives, widened by the break-even split rule
params.verifier: p3_batch_stark_c3np::verify_batch_with_next_row_columns with F's opened next-row sets (a superset of the derived sets, checked) and zero for omitted entries (C3n's verify_batch is the same call with the derived sets)
